files.README.md:
# Yarwell Appliances - warranty cover

Domestic appliances built by Yarwell carry the cover in `warranty/cover.csv`, one row per model with the parts and labour terms in years. The sheet covers manufacture faults only; accidental damage is sold separately under the Yarwell Care plan and never appears on the cover sheet.

Registration detail is kept under `docs/`.

files.docs/registration-notes.md:
# Registration notes

Cover starts on the delivery date once the warranty is registered online. The model plate inside the door lists the full model code; the cover sheet is indexed by the range name.
